description: Whether an accident or incident report (the FAA's statement or preliminary notice, or the NTSB's record), the FAA's aircraft registry and an ADS-B track are one airplane at one time and place: the identity check a Studio crash draft is held to. The report's N-number must be in the registry with a Mode S code (the registry's MASTER file, MODE S CODE HEX), the track must be that address's (adsb.lol's '~' pseudo-addresses never are), and the track must have a report in the window the report's local time gives -- 60 minutes before it to 15 after, at each UTC offset the place may have that day, or the whole local day without a time; with no offset given, every US offset, UTC-11 to UTC+10 (49 CFR part 71) -- within 20 nm of a town's point or 10.5 nm of a point the NTSB gives (10 nm for the receivers' coverage lost low before the place, plus the place's own doubt; ADS-B's own fix is within 0.05 nm, 14 CFR 91.227(c)(1)(i)). The tolerances are this check's judgment, not a regulation. Verdict: confirmed where all agree; no_track where the registry agrees and the track has no report in the window (a draft of the place alone, never a guessed path); needs_human for anything else.

n_number.description: The N-number the report gives; null or missing where it gives none.

date.description: The local date of the event, YYYY-MM-DD.

time.description: The local clock time, HH:MM (24-hour); null or missing where the report gives none or gives no a.m. or p.m.

utc_offsets_min.description: The offsets from UTC the place may have that day, minutes (-360 for CST); empty or missing for every US offset.

place.description: town: a town's internal point (Census gazetteer); point: a point the record gives.

registry.description: The FAA registry's answer for the report's N-number; null or missing where it has none.

track.description: The ADS-B track of that address over the window's UTC days; null or missing where there is none.

checks.description: Each check made, in order (registry, then track or address, window, place), with what it found in words.

nearest.description: The track's report in the window nearest the place, with its distance; null where it has none.
